rules.text: Boons are a special kind of buff generally created by powerful magical or crafting effects that physically alter the character in some way. Players have 3 total boon slots and cannot accept any more until a boon is removed. Boons expire at the end of the event unless otherwise stated in the boon. A player may not have more than 1 instance of the same boon.

expiryKinds.text: Expires at the end of the event (default).
Lasts until the end of the Event if never used, or until the end of the Encounter once used or activated.
Permanent. May be removed by the user after a 60 Count; the item is destroyed on removal.
Made permanent by Boon Extender; can be activated once per Repop instead of disappearing.

modifiers.name: Cure Boon
modifiers.text: Removes a Permanent Boon of the user's choice from one of their Boon Slots.

modifiers.name: Boon Extender
modifiers.text: Mixed with a stable Biologic Intervention item that grants a boon; the boon becomes a Permanent (Lasting) boon usable once per Repop.

boons.name: Slap in the Face
boons.text: Remove a Sleep Effect from yourself after spending a 10 Count.

boons.name: Raging Healer
boons.text: Activate at any time to grant +5 Health to all Healing you provide or receive.

boons.name: Tougher Stuff
boons.text: Remove a Disease or Weakness Effect from yourself after spending a 10 Count.

boons.name: Bloodline Enhancement
boons.text: Activate to choose an Ancestry Ability. Until the end of the Encounter, each use of it gives an additional use (extra uses do not trigger this). Remaining extra uses are lost at the end of the Encounter.

boons.name: Bionic Ears
boons.text: Call Sidestep in response to any surprise attack.

boons.name: Bionic Eyes
boons.text: Call "Point Reveal" on a hidden character; then a 10 count to recharge.

boons.name: Bionic Arms
boons.text: +1 Damage to all Melee and Ranged Attacks.

boons.name: Coagulation Response Device
boons.text: Bleedout Count increased by a minute.

boons.name: Aware Healing Patch
boons.text: The Aware gains the effects of normal Healing at half effectiveness (Heal 10 restores 5; Heal to Full heals to half max Health).

boons.name: Bionic Limbs
boons.text: Call "Resist Interrupt" once per attempt while using Rip Free. With Level 5 Rip-Free, Rip Free becomes instant.

boons.name: Biomod Patch
boons.text: Doubles gained benefits and halves counts of the linked augmentation boon. Destroyed if the linked boon is removed.

boons.name: Auto-Defibrillator
boons.text: Once per Encounter, a single use of Endurance followed immediately by a single use of Dash.

boons.name: Bionic Fist
boons.text: +3 Steel Damage when attacking with fists (contact-safe boffers still required).

boons.name: Bionic Muscles
boons.text: Once per Encounter, call "Mimic" and copy a Physical Attack or Defense call you see another character perform (Rulebook skills only).
